note: Small M.D. of Bonnyville lake park 8 km west on Hwy 55 and 10 km north on Hwy 897 from Cold Lake. Boat launch, dock, unsupervised swimming area, fish-cleaning stand, picnic shelter, playground and horseshoe pits; firewood on site. Sites 5-7 are 25 ft. No dogs on the beach; OHVs prohibited. On the park map, sites 4, 5 and 6 face the lake; the rest sit back on the far side of the loops. --Claude
summary: Read the M.D. of Bonnyville page, the Let's Camp camp/site API and the park map: 11 non-power sites (25-40 ft, max RV 40 ft), outhouses, non-potable hand pump; season derived May-Sep -> May 8 - Sep 6 2026; reservable on Let's Camp (14-night max). Rate UNREAD (no prices out of season). Lakefront kept with a caveat naming sites 4-6. Phone 780-826-2245 suggested.
flags: FEES UNREAD: the M.D. page posts no rates ('Campground rates and reservation website addresses may be subject to change. All prices are subject to GST and site fees.'); Let's Camp gives minimumPrice null and every site's startingNightlyRate null out of season (futureAvailableDates empty). No rate written; Let's Camp says includeTax false (GST extra) - not written without a rate.
PHONE (stored empty): '(780) 826-2245' is the phone on the Let's Camp camp record (the M.D. of Bonnyville parks line, also on the M.D. page for cabin rentals). Recommend 780-826-2245.
WEBSITE: both stored lines answered 200 and are right: the M.D. page lists all its parks with an Ethel Lake section; letscamp.ca/camps/ethel-lake is this park's booking page.

WATERFRONT (stored lakefront, kept, with a caveat): the park map shows two loops between the access road and Ethel Lake, with site 4 at the lake end of the south loop and sites 5 and 6 on the lake side of the north loop, the boat launch and dock between. On the 2021-07-01 Esri capture the lake-side RVs of the north loop sit ~15-20 m from the waterline across open sand/grass apron with boats pulled up on it, and the RVs at the south loop's lake end ~12-20 m across open beach; the remaining sites (1-3, 7-11) sit ~40-80 m back behind the loops and trees. Recommend lakefront with a caveat naming sites 4, 5 and 6 (few clear waterfront sites rule); the map is schematic, so the site numbers are the map's, not measured.

PIN (54.5435,-110.3340): on the beach at the south loop's lake end, ~45 m S of the campground's middle; Let's Camp's point 54.544212,-110.333827 is in the north loop. Within 250 m; optional move to 54.5439,-110.3340 (between the loops).
ROAD/ACCESS wording: none. 'OHVs are prohibited inside of the park.'
SITE LENGTH: all sites 25 ft or more (sites 5-7 are 25 ft, width 20 ft each) - passes the 23-ft rule.
